checks.basis: Draw state does not permit a silent post-reservation failure path; committed RNG and granted results converge through recovery/recording states.
After RUBY_DEBITED the evolution machine can only grant the evolution, then record it; it cannot transition to an unrecoverable generic failure.
After RESOURCE_DEBITED, mastery converges to applied or cap/overflow accounting and then RECORDED; post-debit silent loss is not an allowed transition.
Idempotency keys and exactly-once receipt helpers return the stored result on replay rather than issuing a second grant.
Login claim decisions are server-period keyed, reject invalid counters and preserve progress when a day is missed rather than resetting the whole track.
Migration fixtures verify deterministic conversion, idempotency and raw legacy backup integrity before accepting an already-migrated payload.

findings.finding: Server locks, provider receipt verification, webhook truth and production persistence are contract requirements only at Step 2; there is no claim that a production backend exists yet.
findings.requiredNextStage: Implement these controls in the authorized backend stage and prove concurrency/replay behavior against the deployed server before production readiness.
